results.title: Son of a Killer
results.overview: After a childhood scarred by the imprisonment of his parents for murder and abuse while in foster care, Tabaré, freshly out of prison himself, embarks on a journey to uncover the painful truth of his past, rebuild fractured family bonds and break free from inherited trauma.

results.title: Flut
results.overview: Jonathan and Dominik work together on a ship. After a while, the two of them find the courage to talk about what they have in common: They’re both afraid to be openly gay.

results.title: Not Alone
results.overview: Mothers and fathers of gay, lesbian, and trans children from Georgia, Moldova, Russia, and Ukraine travel to Berlin to walk together in the Pride parade. Living under one roof, they prepare for the march — painting signs, cooking borscht, and reflecting on how their relationships with their queer children have evolved over the years.

results.title: Salome Learns to Dance
results.overview: A punk tour de force through an actor’s sex dreams as she grapples with her character’s eroticism. The screenwriter plays everyone, including a dog, and wears gender and nudity as a costume—a whole new meaning to “go f**k yourself.”

results.title: The Red Barn
results.overview: The 20th century dreamt of utopia but instead experienced tragedies. This film looks at San Francisco-based Latvian artist and playwright Raimonds Staprāns’ nearly century-long experience of trying to define life and statehood. It constructs an exact replica of one of his paintings, and asks actors to portray characters from his plays. Keeping in mind the symbolically charged image of the red barn in the painting, it deliberately incites arguments between the actors, the director and the crew about the motivations of the characters as well as alternative actions or decisions that they could have taken but did not.

results.title: Tear Your Eyes Away From The Screen
results.original_title: Despega los ojos de la pantalla
results.overview: Time passes, but Cándido doesn't care. Scrolling through the screen of his cell phone, he has all the answers to the mysteries of the universe in front of him. The only answer he can't find, however, is the exact moment of his impending doom.

results.title: The Prisoner
results.overview: The film, set between 1855 and 1860, tells the story of Maria. She is sold by her stepfather to marry Alfredo, son of Manuel, a bankrupt farmer who wants to have an heir. The girl is then confined to the farm, being watched at all times. Until she comes up with a plan in search of freedom.

results.title: Caboose
results.overview: A short train ride in a foreign country

results.title: Just After Dawn
results.overview: Returning from the Atlas lunar mission, the astronauts discover an Earth where humanity has vanished. Cut off from everything, they find themselves confronted with an unfathomable mystery that defies reason.. and threatens their very existence.

results.title: Goon
results.overview: A middle-aged man discovers a new type of internet porn and quickly descends into obsession and violence.

results.title: Jojo Tale
results.overview: Hanmin and Jojo live together. One day, without warning, Jojo loses the ability to eat hamburgers. Soon after, sushi becomes impossible. Finally, even peas. Now, Jojo stops eating altogether. Believing that Jojo is slowly dying, Hanmin desperately searches for something Jojo can still consume and at last, finds it.

results.title: Hell Is Other People
results.overview: After another tense night out, Emma and Chad return to their apartment unable to navigate if they are roommates, lovers, or erring parties.

results.title: Three days until the end of the world
results.original_title: Tres días para el fin del mundo
results.overview: Tomás is ready to leave his village behind. But when he reunites with Carmen, the love he once left behind, he begins to question whether walking away means letting the place he calls home die with him.

results.title: Let There Be Light
results.overview: A flickering streetlight becomes a site of pilgrimage when people begin to believe its flashes spell out “yes” and “no” – guiding them through the unbearable uncertainty of existence.

results.title: Jesse's Birthday 2005
results.overview: When Mark films his friend's birthday party, he finds a stranger slowly intercept the party. Mark must therefore try to figure out the stranger's identity before the stranger completely takes over.

results.title: Watermelon
results.overview: "Sun" sets out to visit "Phlu", who lives in an old apartment building in the middle of the city. When he arrives, he discovers that the building has no running water. He has no choice but to track down six tenants to collect their signatures, as required by the landlord, before the water supply can be restored.  Along the way, "Sun"learns about the struggles of each tenant, all of whom are fighting to get by in a system that keeps pushing them down. As their stories unfold, he begins to see how people are forced to compromise their dignity and moral values just to survive.

results.title: Silent Connections
results.overview: On a rainy afternoon in Mexico City, Gonzalo, a young man from Sonora, burdened by grief and distance, takes refuge on a park bench. There he meets Yolitzli, a deaf young woman from Oaxaca. Through gestures, silence, and falling rain, an unexpected bond emerges between them, transforming the way they communicate and reminding him that true listening reaches far beyond the ears.
